To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

DRG based hospital pricing could improve the efficiency of the Finnish public hospital sector, but only if the system specific features are taken into account and if the DRG based hospital prices are not used in the hospital reimbursement system.
DRG based hospital pricing is not feasible in the Finnish health system, because of the lack of market forces and the absence of a competitive environment.

DRG can be used in the Finnish health system to improve the transparency of hospital costs, and to assist municipalities in their hospital contracting, but that DRG should be applied with caution, and only after careful consideration of the system specific features of the Finnish health care sector.
